reviewNote: Header 111-2 grade 8 exam 3 matches target (range 第四冊 3-5~4-3). Viewed both question pages; page 3 is the answer key (not transcribed). All 25 are multiple choice; 20 figures redrawn from page images. Q4 uses optionFigures; Q22/Q25 are multi-panel SVGs; Q21 text prints triangle as BC with overline (read as triangle ABC); Q21/Q23 drawn with exact ratios so slightly different proportions from the printed figure. Q3 figure kept at printed 91/89 degrees. Unit mapping: nanyi-8-2-3-5 for triangle inequality, 8-2-4-x for parallel/quadrilateral topics.
